exposure: Continuous enteral infusion of chloral hydrate
outcome: Feasibility of continuous enteral chloral hydrate infusion
Days to titration of adequate sedation
cohort: The study included 21 critically ill children under 12 years old, within 72 hours of admission, who were ventilated, receiving enteral tube-feeds, and had intermittent chloral hydrate ordered.
finding: Delivering chloral hydrate by continuous enteral infusion is feasible, effective, and may be associated with less positive fluid balance.
